intro: StorageCafe has no city statistics page for Juneau, and UnitSight did not publish standard (non-climate) rates. The only September 2026 figures are climate-controlled street rates from a page that tracks 1 facility and 2 listings: $195 for a 10x10. That is a thin sample, not a broad market average, and 10x15 and 10x20 were not published. StorageUnitCosts and Storage Stats do not publish Juneau. Once the move-in special ends and the first existing-customer increase lands, the six-month average sits above that climate-controlled rate.
data_asof: Sep 2026 (UnitSight climate-controlled rates only; 1 facility, 2 listings). Standard rates not published. No StorageCafe industry-statistics page; no StorageUnitCosts city page; no Storage Stats market page.

units.notes: UnitSight climate-controlled street rate $95 (Sep 2026). Standard rate not published. Sample is 1 facility and 2 listings.
UnitSight climate-controlled street rate $120 (Sep 2026). Standard rate not published. No reliable lowest-promo figure published for this size (gap).
UnitSight climate-controlled street rate $195 (Sep 2026). Standard rate not published. Not a multi-facility market average. 10x15 and 10x20 were not on the published table.

local_tips: Juneau's published table is too small to treat as a citywide average. The figures are the climate-controlled rates UnitSight printed for September 2026, and nothing was filled in for missing sizes.
Extra Space's published admin fee is $50 on StorageUnitCosts' fee notes, higher than our $29 default; adjust the calculator if your facility charges more.
